artifacts.summary: Decides writer-side enforcement (write-time hook mirroring validate-handoff-location.sh) over postflight normalization, wires the mandatory durable trace at the existing discarded validate-handoff.sh call, and rules to relax the sorry_inventory/continuation_path WARNs.

memory_candidates.content: When a validator's hard FAIL result is invoked only as a 'log-only, non-gating diagnostic' (exit code discarded via `|| true`), check whether any durable recorder (events.jsonl / detected_defects) was ever wired beside it -- a correctly-strict validator can still be a dead signal if nothing downstream consumes its exit code. Look for the system-defect-discrimination.md 'Class (a) loud but unactioned' pattern and copy an existing recorder block (e.g. HANDOFF_STALE_OR_ABSENT in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh) verbatim rather than designing a new one.

For an unforgettable per-dispatch writer obligation on a specific filename (e.g. .orchestrator-handoff.json), a PostToolUse hook keyed on tool_input.file_path (matcher Write|Edit) is the proven enforcement point in this codebase -- not a composing-helper script, which an agent can simply decline to call. See hooks/validate-handoff-location.sh as the template: exit 2 after the write (fix-forward, since PostToolUse runs post-write), plus an unconditional system-defect-record.sh call. Known limitation: structurally blind to a Bash-redirect write of the same file; this codebase has already resolved that tension once by deleting the Bash-redirect writer rather than patching the hook -- do not reintroduce a Bash-script-driven direct write as an enforcement mechanism for a Write/Edit-hook-guarded file.
